g.text: Annual gross income vs modeled requirement

g.text: A down payment does not settle the income question.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #54635e

g.text: Nine hypothetical buyers at 2023 first-time-buyer transaction benchmarks; rules reviewed November 16, 2026.

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #54635e

g.text: Four examples have enough cash but insufficient income under the screen. This is not a population estimate. Cash target includes minimum down, net

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #54635e

g.text: transfer tax, CAD 4,000 closing allowance and CAD 10,000 reserve. Available cash above costs/reserve reduces the loan. Where cash is short, income is

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #54635e

g.text: conditional on first having minimum cash. Sources: Statistics Canada 46-10-0099-01; Bank of Canada V122667780/786; CMHC and municipal/provincial
